svg.title: A — Moss-side observatory: 900 by 720 gate annotations
svg.desc: The 900 by 720 baseline crops the near pine to a small upper-left tip. Restore porous branching in that corner, replace the lower smooth bank with a reprojected moss, triad and gravel composition, and keep the approach above the two-line caption zone. Preserve tower and central inlet. The right fleet group recedes at the crop edge but no records are hidden.
svg.text: A / 900×720 — restore corner framing; protect path
Gold: geometry · Mint: preserve/clearance · Cyan dashed: material aspirations
G1 Restore branching, not discs
Baseline has only a clipped tip
Keep porous sky gaps at this gate
K1 Tower remains hero
Right-of-centre + crown air
Do not crop away garden
G2 Three unequal masses, right group recedes
Two water intervals + every eligible identity preserved
K2 Inlet
G3 Inset
K3 Multi-line caption / action zone
No approach continuation or record placed behind chrome
G3 Replace bottom 25–30% bank; reproject shelves, buried triad and bounded gravel inset.
The path bends behind stone above K3; the cropped engawa edge remains inhabited.
M1 Aspirational: soft moss, damp stone contacts, matte gravel and weathered timber.
This gate uses the landscape eye; 720×900 is the separate tall-eye profile.
Material notes and water envelopes are intent, not measured candidate compliance.
Baseline: outputs/holistic/day-900x720.png · Annotation layout is not production camera/chrome geometry.
